content.text: {"summary":"Hidden unit 0 is always inactive on [-1,1]^3, because its maximum pre-activation is about -0.15. It is repurposed as a linear velocity channel: z0 = ReLU(v+2), which stays active across the domain, and W2[0] = -0.2. This adds -0.2*v - 0.4, so b2 is raised by 0.4 to cancel the constant. Everything else is unchanged on the domain. The original damping slope at the origin is estimated by hand as roughly c ≈ 0.42, giving about 0.62 after the edit.","estimated_c":0.42,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[0,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[0],"value":2.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[0],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.39832287}]}
